_comment: IHE-PCD ACM Clinical Device Database — Consumer-side calibration data.

filter_params._comment: Two-axis adaptive filter tuning. horizon_T [s] couples the FIR window s_j(t) and the hysteresis rate rho=(1-SDC)/T; alpha balances SDC_score between the peak threat max(v_j) and the diffuse sum (alpha = 0.5 per thesis 3.4.4; all thesis results use this value). delta_eval [s] is the step of the periodic evaluation grid T_P (thesis 3.4.5), must satisfy 0 < delta_eval <= horizon_T.

priority_map._comment: BICEPS AlertCondition.Priority -> static SDC priority P_j.

odds_ratios._comment: FHIR diagnosis/danger code -> OR_d for Context_Log_Odds = ln(O_0) + sum(R_d * ln(OR_d)). Unknown codes default to OR=1.0 (neutral).

device_profiles._comment: Bayesian reliability priors: Manufacturer -> ModelName -> ConceptCode -> {sensitivity, false_alarm_rate}. Stage 2 (ClinicalRiskFilter). prior=0.005.

SDC Demo._comment: Screenshot demo for Kapitel 3.2.5 (experiments/screenshots/demo_scenario.py, MDIBs testbed/mdib/*_demo_mdib.xml). Weights w_j = ln(TPR/FPR) reproduce the worked example of Kapitel 3: 5 / 3 / 2.5 / 3, mean 3.375. Fictional values, not calibration data.

Infinity Monitor._comment: Bedside patient monitor — HR channel. Calibrated for escalation testing: LR+ = 0.99/0.01 = 99 → w_j = ln(99) ≈ 4.595.

Evita Ventilator._comment: Mechanical ventilator — airway pressure. Calibrated for escalation testing: LR+ = 0.99/0.01 = 99 → w_j = ln(99) ≈ 4.595.

Space Perfusor._comment: Syringe infusion pump — line pressure. Calibrated for escalation testing: LR+ = 0.99/0.01 = 99 → w_j = ln(99) ≈ 4.595.

Acme Medical._comment: Legacy single-device profiles from the early test phase (reference provider no longer in the repository).
